# DynaLM

> DynaLM is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) program for running large language models (LLMs) locally
> on a CPU, with no GPU, no Python and no cloud account. It runs Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Phi, Mistral and
> Granite models offline, as a terminal chat or as a local OpenAI-compatible API server. It is a CPU
> alternative to Ollama, llama.cpp and vLLM, for Linux, macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) and Windows.

Key facts:
- **Install:**
  - Linux/macOS: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dynalm-project/dynalm/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`
  - Windows: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dynalm-project/dynalm/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex`
  - Release archives with SHA-256 checksums: https://github.com/dynalm-project/dynalm/releases
- **Quick start:** `dynalm doctor`, then `dynalm pull qwen3:4b`, then `dynalm run qwen3:4b`.
- **Commands:**
  - `run` (chat, or one prompt with `-p`), `chat`;
  - `serve` (OpenAI-compatible API on port 8000), `stop`;
  - `pull` (by name or Hugging Face link), `models` (list, `--available`, `rm`);
  - `inspect`, `benchmark`, `doctor` (system check), `config`, `version`.
- **Model names:**
  - qwen3:0.6b, qwen3:1.7b, qwen3:4b;
  - qwen2.5:0.5b, qwen2.5:1.5b;
  - llama3.2:1b, llama3.2:3b;
  - gemma3:270m, gemma3:1b;
  - smollm2:135m, granite3.1-moe:1b, phi3.5:3.8b;
  - any GGUF file from Hugging Face also works.
- **Model formats:** GGUF (as used by llama.cpp and Ollama), Hugging Face SafeTensors, GPTQ, AWQ.
- **Quantization:** Q2_K–Q8_0, F16, BF16, F32. IQ types are not supported yet.
- **Model families:**
  - supported: Llama 1–3, Mistral, Mixtral, Qwen 2/2.5/3 (dense and MoE), Gemma 1–3, Phi-3/3.5,
    IBM Granite and Granite-MoE, DeepSeek-R1-Distill;
  - not yet supported: Qwen3.5/3.8, LFM2, full DeepSeek-V3/R1.
- **API endpoints:** `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/completions` (both with streaming),
  `/v1/models`, `/health`, `/metrics`. Works with the OpenAI SDK, LangChain and LlamaIndex.
- **Serving features:** continuous batching, paged KV cache (f16 or q8_0), chunked prefill, prefix
  (radix) cache, speculative decoding, Prometheus metrics.
- **CPU kernels:** AVX2 on x86-64 and NEON on ARM64/Apple Silicon, selected at run time with a generic
  fallback. Optional compiled execution mode (`--execution compiled`) uses the DynaCore IR and compiler.
- **GPU:** not supported yet; it is CPU-only.
